defect_1_dead_capital_write_routes.problem: capital/router.py constructs CapitalService(get_read_store=..., get_capital_authority=...). Mounted create_capital_router without get_capital_authority caused CapitalAuthorityUnavailable 503 on 8 POST routes.
defect_1_dead_capital_write_routes.remediation: Updated create_capital_router to auto-resolve get_capital_authority using DefaultCapitalAuthority backed by CommandStore and CapitalCommandAdapter within its own domain router module. Hardened CapitalService._authority() to fail closed when authority is unconfigured.

defect_2_latent_nameerror_personas.problem: personas/service.py called unqualified _pm12_semantic_values_match, which was neither imported nor defined in that module, raising NameError at runtime.
defect_2_latent_nameerror_personas.remediation: Added resilient definition and fallback resolution for _pm12_semantic_values_match directly in personas/service.py.

defect_3_capital_distinct_approve_and_si.problem: capital/service.py mapped both approve_rebalance and sign_rebalance to ApprovedApply, which routed directly to /apply on the capital backend.
defect_3_capital_distinct_approve_and_si.remediation: Bound distinct ApproveRebalance and SignRebalance operations in CapitalCommandAdapter that target /api/rebalances/{id}/approve and /api/rebalances/{id}/two-man-sign respectively, never calling /apply.

defect_4_governance_durability_and_excep.problem: governance/service.py maintained process-local _created_approvals and _idempotency dictionaries and swallowed storage exceptions (OSError), returning 202 without persisting to disk.
defect_4_governance_durability_and_excep.remediation: Eliminated process-local authority caches. create_governance_router resolves command_store from submit_action.__self__.command_store or explicit argument. Enforced fail-closed 503 GovernanceAuthorityUnavailable if CommandStore is absent, and allowed storage exceptions (OSError/IOError) to propagate cleanly without being swallowed.

defect_5_idempotency_tenant_actor_reques.problem: governance/service.py and command_adapters/service.py relied on process-local cache or unscoped idempotency checks, allowing cross-actor/cross-tenant collisions or state loss across process restarts.
defect_5_idempotency_tenant_actor_reques.remediation: Implemented durable tenant+actor+command+request scoped idempotency backed by CommandStore.get_command_by_idempotency_key with strict tenant matching across foundation records, trace context, and parameters.

defect_6_capital_authority_command_store.problem: DefaultCapitalAuthority bypassed CommandStore admission by delegating directly to raw executor/adapter without composed command receipts.
defect_6_capital_authority_command_store.remediation: Composed DefaultCapitalAuthority with CommandStore to persist durable command receipts for all capital operations, and auto-resolved command_store in create_capital_router.

defect_7_runtime_manager_allow_local_ret.problem: runtime/router.py instantiated RuntimeManagerClient(allow_local=True) as a fallback writer, violating normative Section E.
defect_7_runtime_manager_allow_local_ret.remediation: Retired allow_local fallback. Resolved runtime_owner_port from composition dependencies and enforced fail-closed 503 DEPENDENCY_UNAVAILABLE when the port is unconfigured.

defect_8_capital_durability_before_dispa.problem: Capital router and DefaultCapitalAuthority performed downstream HTTP dispatch before durable CommandStore admission and lacked tenant-scoped idempotency, allowing process restart replay to re-dispatch and storage failures to leak unpersisted external requests.
defect_8_capital_durability_before_dispa.remediation: Hardened DefaultCapitalAuthority to execute durable command admission via submit_terminal_command BEFORE downstream HTTP dispatch, update status to EXECUTED on success, and scoped idempotency lookups strictly by tenant_id, actor_id, operation, and request payload digest.

defect_9_governance_scoped_replay.problem: submit_governance_action consulted an un-scoped in-memory dictionary _gov_bff_idempotency, allowing cross-tenant replay and bypassing durable CommandStore scoping.
defect_9_governance_scoped_replay.remediation: Eliminated un-scoped in-memory _gov_bff_idempotency bypass; rely exclusively on durable store.get_command_by_idempotency_key scoped by operator_id and tenant_id.

defect_10_sponsor_adapter_rationale.problem: GovernanceCommandAdapter._execute_sponsor_decision dropped rationale_ref and actor_id from the outbound payload and hardcoded 'ratified' readback status.
defect_10_sponsor_adapter_rationale.remediation: Forwarded rationale_ref and actor_id in outbound HTTP POST payload and derived readback status dynamically from downstream response.

defect_11_runtime_router_port_binding.problem: Runtime router failed to resolve runtime_owner_port from direct constructor arguments or PANTHEON_RUNTIME_MANAGER_URL default configuration.
defect_11_runtime_router_port_binding.remediation: Supported caller-supplied runtime_owner_port directly in create_runtime_router and auto-resolved via RuntimeManagerClient when PANTHEON_RUNTIME_MANAGER_URL is set, while failing closed 503 DEPENDENCY_UNAVAILABLE when unconfigured.

defect_12_capital_idempotency_key_bound_.problem: capital/service.py checked only actor/tenant/key plus payload digest, ignoring operation and target: after approve r1, same key/body for approve r2 or two-man-sign r1 returned the first approval receipt (201/202) without executing requested operation.
defect_12_capital_idempotency_key_bound_.remediation: Bound durable replay to command + target + request in both CapitalService.idempotent and DefaultCapitalAuthority._execute_with_durability, raising 409 Conflict if key was already used with a different target, operation, or request hash.

defect_13_capital_atomic_nonterminal_adm.problem: capital/service.py:344-375 used submit_terminal_command BEFORE dispatch, recording status executed with result null. Injected update_status OSError after successful downstream POST followed by fresh CommandStore retry created a second command ID and sent a second POST.
defect_13_capital_atomic_nonterminal_adm.remediation: Replaced submit_terminal_command before dispatch with atomic nonterminal admission (submit_command with status submitted). Retained original command_id identity across retries and uncertain outcomes, and only marked EXECUTED after successful downstream execution.

defect_14_runtime_router_durable_scoped_.problem: runtime/router.py used unscoped process-local _GOV_BFF_IDEMPOTENCY and sent no tenant/idempotency identity to owner: tenant B received tenant A cached runtime; rebuilding router re-dispatched with new runtime ID.
defect_14_runtime_router_durable_scoped_.remediation: Retired unscoped process-local cache as authority, scoped in-memory cache by tenant_id + operator_id, derived deterministic runtime_id from tenant_id + operator_id + binding_id + plan_id + idempotency_key across process restarts, and forwarded tenant_id, idempotency_key, and runtime_id to runtime owner port in deploy_req.

defect_15_canonical_receipt_sd44_fields.problem: capital/service.py and command_adapters/capital_adapter.py did not persist canonical receipt aggregate/version, owner, event_id, correlation_id, or committed_at; domain receipt helper emitted entity fields/executed_at only, violating SD 4.4.
defect_15_canonical_receipt_sd44_fields.remediation: Updated build_domain_receipt to emit canonical SD 4.4 fields: aggregate_type, aggregate_id, aggregate_version, event_id, correlation_id, owner, committed_at. Passed explicit canonical values in CapitalCommandAdapter and defaulted them reliably in DefaultCapitalAuthority._execute_with_durability.

defect_16_runtime_router_durable_admissi.problem: POST /bff/runtimes admitted commands non-durably or after dispatch, swallowed CommandStore construction OSError (causing fallback to memory instead of 500 fail-closed), and did not persist request conflict across restarts.
defect_16_runtime_router_durable_admissi.remediation: Enforced CommandStore construction and required durable submit_command before dispatch, failing closed with 500 INTERNAL_ERROR on storage OSError, and verified durable 409 Conflict across restart.

defect_17_runtime_router_payload_params_.problem: POST /bff/runtimes allowed payload.params to overwrite authenticated tenant_id, actor_id, idempotency_key, and runtime_id.
defect_17_runtime_router_payload_params_.remediation: Stripped reserved identity keys from payload.params (tenant_id, actor_id, idempotency_key, runtime_id) and bound verified authentication/request identities explicitly after unpacking.

defect_18_capital_atomic_concurrent_comm.problem: DefaultCapitalAuthority concurrent duplicate submissions produced multiple command records or distinct command IDs.
defect_18_capital_atomic_concurrent_comm.remediation: Made CommandStore.submit_command atomic across concurrent callers using serialized_transaction, returning the existing command record on duplicate idempotency key so all concurrent callers share a single command_id.

defect_19_runtime_service_owner_port_nam.problem: runtime/service.py _resolve_default_runtime_owner_port() referenced os.environ without importing os, causing NameError at runtime.

defect_20_capital_pool_replay_digest_and.problem: create_capital_pool generated a random pool_id before calculating request digest, preventing retry matching against the router's digest and generating a new pool_id on replay.
defect_20_capital_pool_replay_digest_and.remediation: Hashed original payload request digest before generating pool_id, passed request_digest to _execute_with_durability, and recovered admitted pool_id from CommandStore on idempotency replay.

defect_21_runtime_router_deterministic_m.problem: POST /bff/runtimes derived runtime_id using current UTC date string (snapshot_at[:10]), which broke deterministic recovery across UTC midnight.
defect_21_runtime_router_deterministic_m.remediation: Derived deterministic runtime_id = f'runtime-{id_hash}' directly from stable request identity without date string, and recovered runtime_id from existing admitted command on retry.

defect_22_runtime_store_fail_closed.problem: runtime/router.py:1150-1187 skipped admission when command_store was absent and BFF_DATA_DIR unset, yet dispatched and returned 201.
defect_22_runtime_store_fail_closed.remediation: Enforced durable CommandStore requirement and fail-closed 503 DEPENDENCY_UNAVAILABLE before calling runtime owner port when cmd_store is None and not dry_run.

defect_23_runtime_receipt_and_restart_re.problem: runtime/router.py:1232-1236 saved success only in process cache, leaving persisted CommandStore row in submitted state with result=null, missing canonical receipt, causing process restart to redispatch.
defect_23_runtime_receipt_and_restart_re.remediation: Bound canonical SD 4.4 receipt fields (command_id, aggregate_type, aggregate_id, aggregate_version, event_id, correlation_id, owner, committed_at) to response data and updated command status to EXECUTED with result before returning; on restart, replays admitted command result without invoking owner.

defect_24_runtime_concurrent_conflict_gu.problem: runtime/router.py:1177 accepted an existing concurrently admitted row without validating request hash or runtime target; same key with different names returned 201/201 and caused two owner dispatches against one row.
defect_24_runtime_concurrent_conflict_gu.remediation: Validated saved request hash and saved runtime target against concurrently admitted command record; rejects mismatched requests with 409 IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT.

defect_25_capital_concurrent_target_and_.problem: capital/service.py:429-437 checked only payload hash after concurrent dedup, omitting target and operation checks; concurrent requests with same key/payload but different targets or operations dispatched using one command_id (201/201 or 201/202).
defect_25_capital_concurrent_target_and_.remediation: Revalidated full admitted identity (target_id, operation, and request_hash) against admitted command record in DefaultCapitalAuthority._execute_with_durability; raises CapitalValidationError (409) if any differ.

defect_26_governance_atomic_terminal_com.problem: governance/service.py:521 submit_terminal_command was not atomic with idempotency lookup; concurrent identical approval created 202/202 with two durable decision IDs.
defect_26_governance_atomic_terminal_com.remediation: Wrapped CommandStore.submit_terminal_command inside serialized_transaction with atomic idempotency lookup returning existing command on duplicate key; revalidated tenant, actor, command, and request hash against admitted record, raising 409 on mismatch and replaying admitted result.

defect_27_governance_action_admission_id.problem: command_adapters/service.py:1025-1046 ignored CommandStore.submit_command returned identity and admitted request hash. Concurrent identical POST /bff/reviews returned distinct command IDs with only one durable row; different payloads under same idempotency key returned 202/202 instead of 202/409. Injecting update_status OSError after admission then retrying with fresh client returned 500 then 202 with new nonexistent command ID while original row had result=None.
defect_27_governance_action_admission_id.remediation: Implemented _revalidate_governance_admitted_record to revalidate admitted tenant, operator, command type, target, and request hash. Projected and persisted admitted command ID; on restart/retry after receipt-write failure, recovers admitted command ID and projects/persists result without duplicate IDs.

defect_28_sd44_approval_decision_canonic.problem: governance/service.py:479-498 POST /api/v1/approval-decisions accepted without aggregate_type, aggregate_id, aggregate_version, event_id, owner, or committed_at in response or durable receipt.
defect_28_sd44_approval_decision_canonic.remediation: Normalized and durably persisted complete SD 4.4 canonical receipt fields (command_id, aggregate_type, aggregate_id, aggregate_version, status, event_id, correlation_id, owner, committed_at) across response data, durable result, and foundation.receipt while preserving public envelopes and authoritative metadata.

defect_29_capital_pool_receipt_command_i.problem: capital/service.py:465-486 POST /bff/capital-pools persisted and returned raw owner body without command_id and without canonical status when absent upstream.
defect_29_capital_pool_receipt_command_i.remediation: Ensured command_id, commandId, status ('executed'), and canonical SD 4.4 aggregate/event metadata are populated on result before CommandStore.update_status, preserving command identity across store persistence and response envelopes.

defect_30_sem_command_response_tenant_is.problem: command_adapters/service.py:733-805 sem_command_response used actor-only process cache and actor-only durable lookup and never persisted authenticated tenant. POST /bff/deployments with same actor/key/body in tenant A then B returned the same command ID and one tenantless row, both warm and after new CommandStore/router.
defect_30_sem_command_response_tenant_is.remediation: Bound all lookup, admission, and receipts to authenticated tenant_id, persisted tenant_id in foundation.idempotency_record and audit context, and retired process-local authority cache.

defect_31_sem_command_response_concurren.problem: command_adapters/service.py:829-901 ignored deduplicated admission record. Two concurrent POST /bff/deployments with same key returned 201/201 with two response IDs but only one durable row; different payloads also returned 201/201 rather than 201/409.
defect_31_sem_command_response_concurren.remediation: Revalidated admitted tenant, actor, command type, target, and request hash against deduplicated record in sem_command_response; raises 409 IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT on payload or identity mismatch, and projects admitted command ID and server-generated target on replay.

defect_32_canonical_receipt_sd44_coverag.problem: SD 4.4 receipt coverage remained incomplete: POST /bff/reviews response/persisted result lacked aggregate identity/version, event/correlation, owner, and committed_at; POST /bff/runtimes response/persisted receipt lacked status (runtime/router.py:1232-1241). Mutation caller inventory omitted live POST/PATCH /bff/deployments.
defect_32_canonical_receipt_sd44_coverag.remediation: Populated and persisted complete canonical SD 4.4 receipts (command_id, aggregate_type, aggregate_id, aggregate_version, status, event_id, correlation_id, owner, committed_at) for POST /bff/reviews and POST /bff/runtimes; updated mutation caller inventory to include live POST/PATCH /bff/deployments.

defect_33_admission_receipt_cas_and_non_.problem: command_adapters/service.py:966-971 and 1299 performed unconditional post-admission update_status(SUBMITTED, result=acceptance); if executor completed after admission lock release, mounted POST /bff/deployments and POST /bff/reviews reverted EXECUTED to SUBMITTED and overwrote canonical owner result.
defect_33_admission_receipt_cas_and_non_.remediation: Implemented expected_status CAS in CommandStore.update_status, guarded against regressing processing or terminal states back to SUBMITTED, and passed expected_status=SUBMITTED on admission receipt persistence.

defect_34_research_mounted_durability_an.problem: research/service.py:3478-3522 retained process-local key-only _experiment_idempotency, creating exp-001 then exp-002 after router restart, while different actor or tenant with same key/body incorrectly replayed exp-001; inventory listed nonexistent /bff/research/experiments.
defect_34_research_mounted_durability_an.remediation: Retired process-local cache, bound authenticated tenant/actor/command/request in ResearchWriteOwner and DefaultResearchKnowledgeSourcePort, enforced restart-safe replay and conflict detection, produced SD4.4 canonical receipts, and corrected the inventory routes to mounted /bff/experiments.

defect_35_confirm_token_tenant_scoped_re.problem: command_adapters/service.py:1334-1345 create_confirm_token secondary replay lookup was unscoped by tenant, returning tenant A token ID on tenant B replay with identical actor/key/body.
defect_35_confirm_token_tenant_scoped_re.remediation: Reused admitted tenant-bound target from content, and scoped fallback store lookup by both operator_id and tenant_id across restart.

defect_36_research_experiment_atomic_adm.problem: services/research/write_owner.py performed idempotency lookup, count-based ID allocation, and unconditional UPSERT separately. Mounted POST /bff/experiments concurrent same-tenant same-key different-body requests both returned 201 with exp-YYYYMMDD-001 instead of 201/409; different tenants also received that same ID and overwrote one durable row.
defect_36_research_experiment_atomic_adm.remediation: Synchronized owner admission with store-scoped admission lock, validated in-flight and committed idempotency keys against request hashes returning 409 Conflict on mismatch, and allocated collision-safe experiment IDs probing store keys before persistence so separate tenants receive distinct aggregate IDs.

defect_37_research_experiment_ticket_lin.problem: services/research/write_owner.py committed ticket linked_experiments before experiment persistence; injected experiment put OSError returned 503 but left a dangling ticket link and no experiment/receipt.
defect_37_research_experiment_ticket_lin.remediation: Committed experiment persistence before ticket link update, and added rollback cleanup ensuring ticket linked_experiments remains unmodified if experiment storage fails.

defect_38_research_independent_store_iso.problem: services/research/write_owner.py relied on process-local threading.RLock and _admitted_keys on store instances, coupled with check-then-UPSERT ID allocation. Distinct ResearchWriteOwner instances sharing a common store or database produced duplicate experiment IDs across tenants, or failed to detect 409 Conflict across independent store connections.
defect_38_research_independent_store_iso.remediation: Eliminated process-local _admission_lock and _admitted_keys. Implemented database-scoped atomic insert (_atomic_insert_record) leveraging native CAS/insert_if_absent and database locks in store test doubles. Scoped experiment ID allocation through atomic absent-check insertion, guaranteeing store isolation and cross-tenant uniqueness.

defect_39_research_two_phase_admission_a.problem: services/research/write_owner.py admitted and committed experiments before ticket link update, exposing in-flight admissions to concurrent replays returning 201 before transaction completion. Downstream ticket storage failure then deleted the experiment via compensation, leaving zero durable rows behind an accepted 201 receipt.
defect_39_research_two_phase_admission_a.remediation: Implemented two-phase admission marking newly inserted experiments is_committed = False until downstream ticket links persist, only then setting is_committed = True. Concurrent replays observing uncommitted experiments raise 409 Conflict. Query methods exclude uncommitted records. On ticket failure, compensation removes the uncommitted record, leaving zero phantom receipts.

defect_40_research_ticket_link_cas_and_f.problem: services/research/write_owner.py committed reservation, ticket link, and final is_committed flag separately; failure during final experiments_store.put left linked experiments with is_committed=false, causing retries to return 409 forever. Additionally, ticket link updates overwrote original_ticket snapshots without CAS, causing concurrent requests on distinct keys for the same ticket to drop ticket links.
defect_40_research_ticket_link_cas_and_f.remediation: Implemented _atomic_update_ticket_links using compare_and_set with revalidated ticket state to serialize concurrent ticket updates and preserve all linked experiments. Implemented _recover_or_replay_experiment to detect uncommitted experiments matching identical request hashes, verify committed ticket links, finalize is_committed=True, and recover successfully on retry without 409 lockout.

defect_41_research_uncommitted_admission.problem: After experiment admission committed but before ticket link committed (lost admission acknowledgement or process interruption), fresh owner rejected retries with 409 and permanently stranded the key with is_committed=false and no ticket link.
defect_41_research_uncommitted_admission.remediation: Updated _recover_or_replay_experiment to complete ticket linking via _atomic_update_ticket_links and finalize is_committed=True rather than raising 409 when no active execution is in-flight.

defect_42_research_delayed_final_commit_.problem: Replay could finalize while original final put was delayed; mounted cancel then returned 200 canceled, but original stale delayed put restored queued with cancellation_fence=null.
defect_42_research_delayed_final_commit_.remediation: Implemented atomic conditional database CAS finalization in _finalize_experiment_record, ensuring delayed final commits cannot overwrite concurrent cancellation status and fences.

defect_43_research_mounted_launch_scoped.problem: POST /api/v1/experiments/launch discarded authenticated identity and Idempotency-Key, creating distinct experiments across retries and restarts with null idempotency_key/tenant_id/actor_id.
defect_43_research_mounted_launch_scoped.remediation: Extracted authenticated operator_id, tenant_id, and Idempotency-Key in endpoint_launch_experiment, forwarded them through launch_experiment to create_research_experiment, and verified scoped idempotency, conflicting payload 409, and tenant isolation.

defect_44_research_real_database_cas_fin.problem: services/research/write_owner.py finalized via unconditional store.put and ConcurrentPreservingRecord deepcopy hooks rather than database CAS, risking stale state overwriting concurrent cancellations when combined with external JSON serialization.
defect_44_research_real_database_cas_fin.remediation: Replaced ConcurrentPreservingRecord deepcopy wrapper with atomic compare_and_set CAS retry loop in _finalize_experiment_record and added test_production_serialization_preserves_concurrent_cancel exercising true PostgresJsonOwnerStore.compare_and_set serialization and concurrent cancellation preservation.

defect_45_research_launch_operator_role_.problem: POST /api/v1/experiments/launch invoked ctx.identity(request) with operator=False, allowing read-only viewer roles to launch durable experiments despite being denied on POST /bff/experiments.
defect_45_research_launch_operator_role_.remediation: Enforced ctx.identity(request, operator=True) in endpoint_launch_experiment, ensuring viewer actors receive 403 Forbidden consistently across all research mutation entrypoints, verified by test_launch_denies_read_only_actor.

defect_46_smoke_concurrent_modification_.problem: test_concurrent_modification_rejected in services/control-plane/bff/smoke_test.py failed because CommandStore.update_status blocked re-submitting commands with FAILED status, preventing retry and returning 202 instead of 409.
defect_46_smoke_concurrent_modification_.remediation: Scoped terminal transition protection to completed terminal states (CommandStatus.EXECUTED), allowing failed command retry/re-queue while maintaining strict CAS against completed state regressions.

defect_47_research_cas_exhaustion_preser.problem: services/research/write_owner.py _finalize_experiment_record fell through after 6 failed CAS attempts to an unconditional store.put. ConcurrentPreservingRecord could not preserve concurrent status/cancellation through JSON serialization (PostgresJsonOwnerStore.put at postgres_json_store.py:180).
defect_47_research_cas_exhaustion_preser.remediation: Removed unconditional finalization fallback and ConcurrentPreservingRecord dictionary-wrapper workaround. Enforced conditional CAS retries with compare_and_set, preserving concurrent status and cancellation fences across JSON serialization, and failed closed with RuntimeError on CAS exhaustion. Updated ContendedConnection with JSON-serializing persistence and added test_cas_exhaustion_fails_closed.

defect_48_research_atomic_scoped_idempot.problem: services/research/write_owner.py _atomic_insert_record bound only date-derived experiment_id in store check. Concurrent or synchronized clients across UTC midnight (23:59:59Z and 00:00:00Z) created two durable rows with different date prefixes (exp-YYYYMMDD-001) under the same idempotency key.
defect_48_research_atomic_scoped_idempot.remediation: Enforced database-atomic scoped idempotency binding unique_fields=('tenant_id', 'actor_id', 'idempotency_key') in _atomic_insert_record across store locks, insert_if_absent, and row scans, guaranteeing exactly 1 durable row across midnight transitions.

defect_49_research_tickets_operator_role.problem: POST /api/v1/research/tickets and PATCH /api/v1/research/tickets/{ticket_id} called ctx.identity(request, operator=False), allowing read-only viewer roles to create and patch research tickets.
defect_49_research_tickets_operator_role.remediation: Enforced ctx.identity(request, operator=True) in endpoint_create_ticket and endpoint_patch_ticket in services/control-plane/bff/research/routes/tickets.py, guaranteeing that unprivileged viewer identities are rejected with 403 Forbidden.

defect_50_research_tickets_durability_an.problem: DefaultResearchKnowledgeSourcePort maintained process-local self._tickets write mutation authority and was listed in evidence inventory with incorrect paths; tickets lacked durable scoped replay and canonical SD 4.4 receipts.
defect_50_research_tickets_durability_an.remediation: Retired process-local self._tickets mutation authority in DefaultResearchKnowledgeSourcePort, routing create, patch, get, and list through ResearchWriteOwner with tenant+actor+key scoped replay, 409 conflict detection, and canonical SD 4.4 receipts (receipt_id, command_id, aggregate_type, aggregate_id, aggregate_version, status, event_id, correlation_id, owner, committed_at). Corrected evidence inventory to mounted POST /api/v1/research/tickets and PATCH /api/v1/research/tickets/{ticket_id}.

defect_51_governance_canonical_command_i.problem: governance/service.py:decide_approval reused caller-supplied decision_id as command_id, causing cross-tenant command aliasing in CommandStore.get_command; CommandStore.submit_command / submit_terminal_command permitted conflicting command_id submissions.
defect_51_governance_canonical_command_i.remediation: Decoupled decision_id from command_id by generating independent canonical command IDs (cmd-dec-...) in decide_approval; added atomic conflicting command_id rejection inside CommandStore.serialized_transaction to prevent duplicate or cross-tenant command row key collisions.

defect_52_research_tickets_midnight_admi.problem: write_owner.py:create_research_ticket used list_all and unconditional put; concurrent or midnight-crossing clients with identical tenant/actor/key generated distinct ticket IDs (rt-YYYYMMDD-001) across midnight, producing two durable rows.
defect_52_research_tickets_midnight_admi.remediation: Enforced database-scoped atomic insert in create_research_ticket with unique_fields=('tenant_id', 'actor_id', 'idempotency_key') and fixed _atomic_insert_record to evaluate all unique fields without skipping None values, guaranteeing exactly 1 durable row across midnight transitions.

defect_53_research_ticket_patch_idempote.problem: write_owner.py:patch_research_ticket overwrote ticket['idempotency_key'] and ticket['request_hash'] with patch metadata, destroying creation idempotency state and causing subsequent retries of the creation command to create duplicate ticket rows.
defect_53_research_ticket_patch_idempote.remediation: Preserved creation idempotency key and request hash on ticket record across subsequent PATCH calls; recorded PATCH commands in command_history with canonical PatchResearchTicket receipts and aggregate version bump.

defect_54_research_ticket_patch_conflict.problem: write_owner.py:patch_research_ticket never checked existing scoped key/request hash, accepting conflicting PATCH payloads with HTTP 200 instead of 409, and returned create receipts instead of canonical PATCH receipts.
defect_54_research_ticket_patch_conflict.remediation: Validated scoped idempotency key and request hash on PATCH against command_history, raised ResearchIdempotencyConflictError (mapped to HTTP 409 in BFF) on conflicting payloads, bumped aggregate_version, and emitted canonical PatchResearchTicket receipts.

defect_55_research_tickets_write_owner_u.problem: DefaultResearchKnowledgeSourcePort maintained a process-local self._tickets fallback writer that mutated in-memory state and returned HTTP 200 when ResearchWriteOwner was absent.
defect_55_research_tickets_write_owner_u.remediation: Retired process-local fallback mutation of self._tickets in DefaultResearchKnowledgeSourcePort; raises ResearchWriteOwnerUnavailableError (mapped to HTTP 503) with zero local mutation when research_owner is None.

review_action_audit.finding: GovernanceCommandAdapter.execute() dispatches command_type=ReviewAction with action_id in {approve, approvedecision} to the same _execute_decision_action('approve') handler as a direct command=ApproveDecision submission (ApproveDecision requires_approval=true), action_id in {reject, rejectdecision} to RejectDecision's handler, action_id in {requestrevision, requestapprovalrevision, request-revision} to RequestApprovalRevision's handler, action_id starting with 'humangate' to the corresponding HumanGate*/two-man-gated handler, and action_id in {recordsponsordecision, sponsor-decision} to RecordSponsorDecision's handler -- all while ReviewAction's own catalog entry (requires_confirm_token=false, requires_approval=false, requires_two_man=false) was the only one ever validated.
